metadata.title: Women and Child Safety Departments & Facilities in Pune
metadata.description: Geographical coordinates, contact details, jurisdictions, and operational roles of government administrative offices, police safety cells, judicial bodies, crisis intervention centers, and emergency helplines for women and child safety in Pune.

departments.name: Commissionerate of Women and Child Development (WCD), Government of Maharashtra
departments.governing_body: Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Maharashtra
departments.role_and_responsibilities: State apex headquarters responsible for the formulation, implementation, and monitoring of policies, legislation, and welfare schemes for women and children across Maharashtra, including Mission Shakti, Mission Vatsalya, and POSH Act compliance.
departments.address: 28, Queen's Garden, near Old Circuit House, Camp

departments.name: State Adoption Resource Agency (SARA), Maharashtra
departments.governing_body: Commissionerate of Women and Child Development, Maharashtra
departments.role_and_responsibilities: State nodal statutory body coordinating, regulating, and monitoring in-country and inter-country adoption of orphaned, abandoned, and surrendered children under CARA guidelines.
departments.address: Commissionerate of Women and Child Development, 28 Queen's Garden, Camp

departments.name: Maharashtra State Commission for Women (Pune Regional Desk)
departments.governing_body: Maharashtra State Commission for Women (Statutory Body)
departments.role_and_responsibilities: Investigating violations of women rights, resolving complaints regarding violence, dowry harassment, sexual abuse, and providing free legal advice and family counseling.
departments.facility_type: Statutory Human Rights / Women Commission Office
departments.address: Divisional Commissioner Office Complex, Council Hall, Camp

departments.name: District Women and Child Development Office (DWCDO), Pune
departments.governing_body: Revenue & Forest / WCD Department, Government of Maharashtra
departments.role_and_responsibilities: District-level executive machinery overseeing women safety shelters, anti-child marriage enforcement, POSH Internal Committees inspections, child institutions registration, and child protection programs.
departments.address: Chunawala Chambers, Abdul Ajiz Memon Path, Tophakhana, Shivajinagar

departments.name: District Child Protection Unit (DCPU), Pune
departments.governing_body: Women and Child Development Department / Mission Vatsalya
departments.role_and_responsibilities: Field-level child protection body managing rescue operations for children in distress, street children, child laborers, child abuse victims, foster care, sponsorship, and institutional rehabilitation.
departments.address: Bungalow No. 5, Param Anand, near Old Circuit House, Queen's Garden, Camp

departments.name: Pune City Police - Bharosa Cell Headquarters (Cops Hub)
departments.role_and_responsibilities: Pioneering integrated police center offering crisis support, legal consultation, psychiatric counseling, and dispute resolution for women, children, and senior citizens under one roof.
departments.address: Old CID Office Building, Sangam Bridge, near Sangamwadi Road, Shivajinagar

departments.name: Pune City Police Headquarters - Women Safety Desk & Damini Squad HQ
departments.role_and_responsibilities: Headquarters of the dedicated all-women rapid intervention bike/patrol squad (Damini Pathak) securing schools, colleges, IT parks, bus stands, and public spaces, alongside the 24x7 Women Control Room.
departments.facility_type: City Police Commissionerate & Quick Response Unit
departments.address: Police Commissioner Office, 2 Sadhu Vaswani Road, Agarkar Nagar, Camp

departments.name: Special Juvenile Police Unit (SJPU), Pune City Police
departments.role_and_responsibilities: Specialized juvenile protection police unit enforcing the Juvenile Justice Act, investigating POCSO cases, missing children complaints, and coordinating with CWC and juvenile homes.
departments.address: Crime Branch, Police Commissioner Office, Sadhu Vaswani Road, Camp

departments.name: Pimpri Chinchwad Police - Bharosa Cell & Women Safety Wing
departments.role_and_responsibilities: Comprehensive women and child protection desk, domestic counseling, and emergency intervention for the industrial twin cities of Pimpri-Chinchwad and surrounding suburban zones.
departments.address: Police Commissioner Office, Premlok Park Road, Indira Nagar, Bhoirnagar, Akurdi / Chinchwad

departments.name: Child Welfare Committee (CWC), Pune District
departments.governing_body: Department of Women & Child Development / Judicial Bench
departments.role_and_responsibilities: Statutory bench with powers of a First Class Judicial Magistrate to decide the care, custody, rehabilitation, and long-term protection of children in need of care and protection (CNCP).
departments.address: Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Udyog Kendra (PJNUK) Campus, M10, Golf Club Road, Ashok Nagar, Yerawada

departments.name: Juvenile Justice Board (JJB) & Juvenile Court, Pune
departments.governing_body: District & Sessions Court / Women & Child Development
departments.role_and_responsibilities: Special judicial tribunal comprising a Principal Magistrate and two social workers adjudicating cases involving Children in Conflict with Law (CCL), focusing on counseling, reform, and rehabilitation.
departments.address: M10, Golf Club Road, Ashok Nagar, Yerawada

departments.name: Government Observation Home & Children's Home (PJNUK Bal Kalyan Sankul)
departments.governing_body: Commissionerate of Women and Child Development, Maharashtra
departments.role_and_responsibilities: State-run residential care, protective shelter, schooling, and vocational rehabilitation facility for juveniles undergoing inquiry and children requiring emergency state protection.
departments.facility_type: Government Juvenile Observation & Children Shelter Home
departments.address: Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Udyog Kendra, Golf Club Road, Ashok Nagar, Yerawada

departments.name: Family Court, Pune (Matrimonial & Child Custody Center)
departments.governing_body: Judiciary of Maharashtra / High Court of Bombay
departments.role_and_responsibilities: Adjudicating matrimonial disputes, granting domestic violence protection orders, maintenance, divorce, child custody, and conducting mandatory family mediation with trained counselors.
departments.address: Husseny Building, 89, 107/2, Nyaymurti Ranade Path, Tophakhana, Shivajinagar

departments.name: Sakhi One Stop Centre (OSC), Pune
departments.governing_body: Ministry of Women and Child Development (GoI) / Chaitanya Mahila Mandal
departments.role_and_responsibilities: 24x7 emergency one-stop crisis shelter for women facing domestic violence, sexual assault, harassment, or distress, providing integrated emergency medical care, police reporting, legal counseling, and temporary lodging.
departments.address: 1st Floor, Bharat Ratna Late Rajeev Gandhi Hospital, Deccan College Road, Nawanagar, Salwe Nagar, Yerawada

departments.name: Childline 1098 Nodal Centre Pune (Karve Institute of Social Service)
departments.governing_body: Childline India Foundation / Ministry of WCD / Karve Institute
departments.role_and_responsibilities: Nodal coordinating center for 1098 Child Helpline in Pune, executing field rescues for runaway, abused, child-labor, and child-marriage victims, legal follow-ups, and psychological rehabilitation.
departments.address: Karve Institute of Social Service, 18, Hill Side, Hingane Home Colony, Karvenagar

departments.name: Childline Collaborative Outreach Centre (Deep Griha Society)
departments.governing_body: Deep Griha Society / Mission Vatsalya Childline
departments.role_and_responsibilities: Outreach collaborative partner for Childline Pune focusing on high-risk vulnerable zones, railway station surveillance for runaway children, slum outreach, child health support, and crèches.
departments.address: 13, Tadiwala Road, Lumbini Nagar, Sangamvadi, near Pune Railway Station

departments.name: Pune Municipal Corporation - Social Development & Women Welfare Department
departments.role_and_responsibilities: Planning and executing civic women welfare schemes, women self-help groups (SHG / Bachat Gat) financial assistance, mother & child nutritional support, girl-child education subsidies, and free vocational centers.

departments.name: Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation - Women and Child Welfare Department
departments.role_and_responsibilities: Civic department administrating women empowerment programs, maternity benefit schemes, day-care crèches for children of working women, and specialized child nutrition centers in PCMC limits.
departments.address: PCMC Main Administrative Building, Mumbai - Pune Road, Pimpri Colony
